checks.name: migration 26 is transactional, repeatable and preserves legacy business rows
group draw ends tied, rejects extra time and shootout despite stale configured ET duration
direct result API cannot invent an extra-time/penalty score or change canonical events
round robin ends as a draw using its explicitly selected futsal rules, no automatic knockout phase
knockout winner in regulation ends without extra time and without official advancement
penalties-only method rejects extra time through direct clock API
shootout cannot end with a manually supplied aggregate result
READ-only official cannot configure or record a shootout; bench cannot enter IFAB/VFF pool
per-kick idempotency, stale version and ineligible player guard
shootout SSE emits committed update once for an idempotent operation, errors do not emit
early shootout winner stops further kicks; correcting winner reopens, retake preserves turn and player
reload/restart retains exact attempts, version and next state
finished shootout saves stage scores, actual end and PENDING result; no standings or bracket advancement
finished shootout is immutable through regular kick API and audit cannot be overwritten
ET fixture uses the existing published hybrid rule version and blocks skipping extra time
ET goals remain incremental, played total counts them once, and actual end stays pending
shootout cautions reset; a second shootout caution dismisses and forces eligible-pool recheck
IFAB eligibility equalization is mandatory and a player cannot repeat before others
API sudden death waits for equal kicks; keeper replacement inherits its shooting cycle
finished extra-time shootout retains 0–0 incremental ET and 6–5 shootout, never official standings
official five business databases remain unchanged
